name: Uranium Energy

logo.source: uraniumenergy.com pinned-tab vector (https://www.uraniumenergy.com/safari-pinned-tab.svg), the UEC lettermark with company name; monochrome black; viewBox cropped to the artwork. The site's PNG logo is only 152x64 and there is no Wikipedia page.

description: Uranium Energy is a US uranium miner that has only just started producing: it restarted its Christensen Ranch in-situ recovery mine in Wyoming in August 2024 and began production at Burke Hollow in South Texas in April 2026, with licensed capacity of about 12.1 million pounds a year across its Wyoming and Texas hubs. So far it has sold none of its own production (it holds it as inventory, 359,260 pounds since commissioning). All of its revenue ($37.3 million in fiscal 2026, $66.8 million in fiscal 2025) came from reselling physical uranium it bought on the spot market, which it holds as a store of value (1,256,000 purchased pounds at 2026-07-31) and sells opportunistically. It runs a deliberately unhedged strategy, so results swing with the uranium price, and it funds itself by selling new stock through at-the-market programs and offerings ($530 million net in fiscal 2026) while posting net losses ($137.3 million in fiscal 2026). Beyond mining it holds a large Athabasca Basin land position in Canada, a 32.6% stake in Anfield Energy and a 7.6% stake in Uranium Royalty Corp, and is pursuing a US uranium conversion plant through UR&C.

hq.note: 500 North Shoreline, Ste. 800; second principal office in Vancouver, British Columbia (FY2026 10-K cover). Incorporated in Nevada.

employees.note: 201 in the US, 36 in Canada, 20 in Paraguay (FY2026 10-K)

businessLines.name: Mining (Wyoming and Texas in-situ recovery; Athabasca Basin and other development projects)
businessLines.how: Intended model: sell uranium concentrate (U3O8) from its ISR mines to utilities at spot or contract prices, with no hedging. Today it is pre-revenue from mining: output is stockpiled, and the line spends cash on wellfields, drilling and permitting.
businessLines.description: Operating ISR mines Christensen Ranch (Wyoming; Irigaray plant, 4 million lb/yr licensed) and Burke Hollow and Palangana (South Texas; Hobson plant, 4 million lb/yr licensed), plus development projects Sweetwater, Ludeman, Reno Creek and Moore Ranch (Wyoming) and Roughrider and the UEX portfolio (Saskatchewan).

revenue.note: No sales of mined uranium: 'No uranium inventory produced from our Christensen Ranch Mine or Burke Hollow Mine was sold during Fiscal 2026 and Fiscal 2025.' Output was 229,294 lb in FY2026 (211,942 Christensen Ranch plus 17,352 Burke Hollow) and 129,966 lb in FY2025.

businessLines.revenueNote: No sales of mined uranium: 'No uranium inventory produced from our Christensen Ranch Mine or Burke Hollow Mine was sold during Fiscal 2026 and Fiscal 2025.' Output was 229,294 lb in FY2026 (211,942 Christensen Ranch plus 17,352 Burke Hollow) and 129,966 lb in FY2025.

operatingProfit.note: Loss before income taxes (the CODM measure; no segment operating income is reported): Wyoming $(70.5)M, Texas $(31.2)M, Saskatchewan $(17.7)M, Others $(1.5)M. FY2025 mining loss before taxes $(79.19)M.

businessLines.name: Corporate (physical uranium trading and investments)
businessLines.how: Buys physical uranium when spot is below industry mining cost and resells it when price or cash needs warrant, earning the spread; lumpy, with revenue in only two of the last four quarters.
businessLines.description: Physical Uranium Program: buys drummed uranium at spot and sells when prices and cash needs suit; also holds equity investments (Anfield Energy 32.6%, Uranium Royalty Corp 7.6%) and unallocated corporate costs.

revenue.note: Sales of 400,000 lb of purchased uranium at a weighted average $93.13/lb; cost of purchased uranium $20.355M; gross profit $16.90M.
